package.description: Screen splitting application for smarter multitasking

en-US.description: Screen splitting application for smarter multitasking
en-US.longDescription:
Easy Setting Box SW enables users to partition the screen into various layouts of multiple sections to make multi-tasking easier.
This powerful tool enhances productivity by easily organizing multiple window screens.
Highlights
- Conveniently manage multiple screens through various given layouts
- Locate window screens with one simple click into a selected layout
- Manually adjust each window size even in a designated layout
en-US.name: Easy Setting Box

zh-CN.description: 分屏应用，助力高效多任务处理
zh-CN.longDescription:
Easy Setting Box SW 能让用户将屏幕划分为多种分区布局，轻松实现多任务处理。
这款强大工具通过便捷的多窗口管理，显著提升工作效率。
核心功能
- 通过预设多样布局，轻松管理多个屏幕窗口
- 一键点击即可将窗口定位到选定布局区域
- 即使在固定布局中，仍可手动调节每个窗口尺寸
